relationships.subject: electrocautery
relationships.evidence_quote: the mRNA levels of both Sprr1a and Anxa10 in the spinal cord were more potently and persistently increased by electrocautery than by incision

relationships.subject: electrocautery
relationships.evidence_quote: electrocautery significantly decreased the level of H3K27me3 with a significant increase in the level of H3K27ac at the promoter region of the Sprr1a and Anxa10 genes in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: GSK-J4
relationships.evidence_quote: electrocautery-induced overexpression of Sprr1a and Anxa10 was significantly reduced by systemic administration of GSK-J4

relationships.subject: GSK-J4
relationships.evidence_quote: persistent allodynia at 17 days after electrocautery was dramatically suppressed in GSK-J4-treated mice compared to that in vehicle-treated mice

key_findings: Electrocautery produces persistent allodynia with sustained Sprr1a and Anxa10 upregulation in activated spinal neurons, linked to lower H3K27me3 and higher H3K27ac at their promoters.
H3K27 demethylase inhibitor GSK-J4 suppresses allodynia and the gene overexpression.
